description: Details of Ventilation Strategy pursuant to condition 10 of planning permission ref: 250053VAR dated 15/07/2025 for: Minor material amendment (S.73) to vary condition 2 (approved plans), condition 7 (Noise assessment) and condition 8 (Enhanced sound insulation) pursuant to planning permission reference 234841FUL dated 24/12/2024 for 'Development to provide additional hostel accommodation (Sui Generis) with retained access from Queens Walk; facilitated by three storey rear and side extensions with basement levels and courtyard; associated internal and external alterations; and provision of landscaping, car parking, refuse and cycle storage'. Variation seeks to provide amended drawings in respect of minor design amendments to internal layout, roof level, changes to fenestration, changes to lightwells, stairs and access routes, ancillary equipment, acoustics
